info.title: Celigo integrator.io API (baton-celigo connector surface)
info.description: This document describes ONLY the subset of the Celigo integrator.io REST API that the baton-celigo connector (pkg/celigo) calls. It is not a full description of the vendor's API. Scope was derived from pkg/celigo/client.go, pkg/celigo/user.go, and pkg/celigo/integration.go, and the shapes were settled against Celigo's public developer documentation (developer.celigo.com, docs.celigo.com) where available.

servers.description: US region (default). Selected when the connector's `region` config field is "us" (the default) and `base-url` is not set.
EU region. Selected when the connector's `region` config field is set to "eu".

get.description:
Returns all workspace users with access to the account (the account owner is not included, only invited/shared users appear). Called by baton-celigo for the user resource sync (pkg/connector/users.go) and reused to compute role grants (pkg/connector/roles.go), filtering client-side on `accessLevel`.

Pagination: RFC 5988 `Link` response header with `rel="next"`. The connector follows the opaque next-page URL verbatim (pkg/celigo/integration.go/user.go: `resp.Header.Get("Link")`) until the header is absent; it sends no query parameters of its own.

200.description: OK - array of user access records.

Link.description: RFC 5988 pagination link. Contains a `rel="next"` URL with an opaque `after` cursor when more results exist; absent on the last page.

204.description: No users exist in the account.

401.description: Unauthorized - the bearer token is missing or invalid.

put.summary: Update a user's account access level
put.description:
Replaces a workspace user's access settings. Called by baton-celigo during Grant/Revoke on the role resource (pkg/connector/roles.go -> pkg/celigo/user.go UpdateAccessLevelOnUser) to set a user's account-level `accessLevel` to "monitor", "manage", or "administrator" (revoke sets it back to "monitor").

Note on request body: the connector builds the JSON body from the full `User` Go struct with only `AccessLevel` populated, and no `omitempty` tags are present, so the literal wire body also sends `_id: ""`, `integrationAccessLevel: null`, `accountSSORequired: false`, and an empty `sharedWithUser` object alongside the intended `accessLevel`. Per vendor docs, this endpoint treats omitted/zero-valued fields as clearing the corresponding setting (except `accountSSORequired`), so in practice this call also clears any per-integration access overrides on the target user. This is existing client behavior, not a property of the API surface; flagging here per the build-openapi-spec procedure rather than silently normalizing it away.

parameters.name: _id
parameters.description: The user's account access-record ID (ashare ID), taken from `principal.Id.Resource` in pkg/connector/roles.go.

204.description: No Content - user access settings updated.

400.description: Bad Request - body grants no access, or echoes the read-only `userType` field.

401.description: Unauthorized - the bearer token is missing or invalid.

403.description: Forbidden - called from a sandbox environment.

get.description:
Returns all integrations in the account. Called by baton-celigo for the integration (App) resource sync (pkg/connector/integrations.go -> pkg/celigo/integration.go ListIntegrations).

Pagination: RFC 5988 `Link` response header with `rel="next"`, followed the same way as /v1/ashares. The connector sends no query parameters (no `limit`/`include`/`exclude`, though the vendor API supports them).

Link.description: RFC 5988 pagination link. Contains a `rel="next"` URL with an opaque `after` cursor when more results exist; absent on the last page.

401.description: Unauthorized - the bearer token is missing or invalid.

get.summary: List account shares (users) for a specific integration
get.description:
Returns the account-share (ashare) records for users who have been granted access to a specific integration's owning account, each with the user's per-integration access level. Called by baton-celigo to compute grants for the integration (App) resource (pkg/connector/integrations.go -> pkg/celigo/integration.go ListIntegrationsUsers); the connector grants `user.AccessLevel` from each entry directly against the integration resource.

Pagination: same RFC 5988 `Link` header convention as the other list endpoints in this spec.

Provenance note: this sub-resource path was not found directly on the current developer.celigo.com integrations reference page (fetched 2026-10-01); its existence, path shape, and response fields were corroborated via search-indexed content citing the literal path and an example response payload (accessLevel, _id, accepted, accountSSORequired, accountMFARequired fields), and by analogy with the account-level /v1/ashares schema. Treat the response schema here as settled-but-less-certain than the other three operations in this document.

parameters.name: _id
parameters.description: The integration's ID, taken from `resource.Id.Resource` in pkg/connector/integrations.go.

200.description: OK - array of user access records scoped to this integration.

Link.description: RFC 5988 pagination link. Contains a `rel="next"` URL with an opaque `after` cursor when more results exist; absent on the last page.

204.description: No users shared on this integration.

401.description: Unauthorized - the bearer token is missing or invalid.

bearerAuth.description: Celigo integrator.io personal access token, supplied by the user via the `celigo-access-token` connector config field and sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (pkg/connector/connector.go: uhttp.NewBearerAuth(accessToken)).

Integration.description: Fields read by the connector from an integration record (pkg/celigo/integration.go). The vendor's Integration object has additional fields (settings, flowGroupings, apiGroupings, _connectorId, _templateId, readme, createdAt, lastModified, deletedAt, etc.) that the connector does not read and which are therefore out of scope for this spec.

_id.description: Integration's object ID (24-character hex string). Read-only.

name.description: Integration display name. 1-100 characters, required on creation.

description.description: Free-text description of the integration's purpose/behavior. Optional, up to 5120 characters.

IntegrationAccessLevelEntry.description: One per-integration access override for a user, as returned in `User.integrationAccessLevel`.

_integrationId.description: The integration's object ID this access-level entry applies to.

accessLevel.description: Per-integration access level. Narrower than the account-level `accessLevel` enum (no "administrator" or "none" at this scope). See pkg/celigo/access_level.go IntegrationsAccessLevels.

UserSharedDetails.description: Identity/auth metadata for the invited user, nested under `User.sharedWithUser`. Only the fields the connector reads are modeled; the vendor object also includes `_id`, `name`, and `lastSignIn`.

email.description: Invited user's email address, used by the connector as both login and external ID.

allowedToResetMFA.description: Whether the user is allowed to reset their own MFA.

accountSSOLinked.description: Whether this user's SSO identity is linked, and to which account.

User.description: An account-share (ashare) record describing one user's access to the account or to a specific integration, as read by pkg/celigo/user.go and pkg/celigo/integration.go. The vendor's User/ashare object has many additional fields (createdAt, lastModified, accepted, disabled, dismissed, lastSignIn, provisionedBy, externalId, _scimSsoClientId, accountMFARequired, ssoSetupPending, allowAccessToAPIM, allowToEditRetryData, allowIntegrationWorkspaceCreation, createdVia, userType, isProductionAdmin, etc.) that the connector does not read and which are therefore out of scope for this spec.

_id.description: Access-record (ashare) object ID. Used by the connector as the user resource's primary ID and as the `{_id}` path parameter on PUT /v1/ashares/{_id}.

accessLevel.description: Account-level access. On GET this reflects the user's current account access; on PUT the connector sets this to grant/revoke the "role" resource (monitor/manage/administrator). May be omitted when the user only has per-integration access.

integrationAccessLevel.description: Per-integration access overrides for this user.

accountSSORequired.description: Whether SSO is required for this user's account.
